observedIntent: Small piloted hostile air-UAV classifier plus explicit additional classes; size5, airborne>0.3m, moving/piloted checks by default.
Approach-speed/direction test (speed>4m/s, dot>0.8) with150m local actor search;35m hearing substitute or VIEW visibility>0.15;12m panic proximity.
Same-side nearby15m warning spread with short stagger, brief1..5-shot response then8..60s flee,6s calm and4s cooldown.
Flee chooses35..80m away, seeks nearby terrain cover, occasional close dive and audible warning.
methodsToAdapt: Use current CBE native/observed threat and bounded owner-local danger FSM rather than permanent0.25s allUnitsUAV plus per-drone/per-actor work.
Approach prediction and threat urgency should use observed position/velocity with finite freshness, owner epoch and target allegiance. Do not reveal hidden drones globally.
Finite actor evasion should keep mission/specialist/native tasks authoritative, reserve movement, validate cover path, and restore only exact settings it changed.
Buddy warning may propagate an observation with uncertainty; do not recursively confer exact target knowledge or action authority.
methodsRejected: Fired handler changes projectile direction and velocity to manufacture misses. Preserve native ballistics and natural AI accuracy instead.
forceWeaponFire, forced weapon selection and unconditional fire response can bypass mission fire policy; use existing native firearm/ROE and friendly-lane authority.
Blanket re-enable of AUTOCOMBAT/TARGET/AUTOTARGET/SUPPRESSION/COVER, saved behaviour/mode/stance restoration and forceSpeed-1 can overwrite later mission state.
Scheduled actor routines do not revalidate locality/task ownership at each delayed stage; busy/cool variables alone are insufficient ownership receipts.
Repeated free doMove/CARELESS/BLUE/UP overexisting tasks is not a CBE integration.

selectedVisualApproach20261030.sourceIntent: Recognise a small hostile approaching UAV and give exposed infantry a timely finite defensive reaction. Source uses approach dot/speed/proximity, sight/hearing substitute, brief shooting/fleeing and local warning.

disposition.rejected: Assumed35m hearing, projectile redirection to manufacture misses, forced weapon fire/selection, blanket AI flag/posture/behaviour/speed restore, unbounded per-drone controllers and motion over existing tasks.

execution: CortexGroupTick reuses its existing<=8 CortexKnowledge rows and <=64 actor roster. CortexUAVApproach admits recent age<=1s/error<=5m living hostile Air unitIsUAV with world-scaled native model diameter<=5m. Rotate one candidate and an8member window; source pose is not polled globally.

One personally known, nonignored <=1s native sighting from a local eligible idle foot observer precedes a targeted VIEW check. Only a visible, airborne source within120m may have live velocity read. Relative speed>4m/s, closing cosine>0.8, ETA0..4s and projected miss<=6m qualify. Hidden/nonclosing/hovering/high-overflight and stale/group-only observations refuse.

Publish the distinct UAV_APPROACH cause with original observation+1s geometry/identity bounds through existing DangerRequest. It never fabricates a native HIT/PROXIMITY record. Existing finite danger FSM ranks it6 (below immediate HIT/CANFIRE/SUPPRESSED), revalidates actual hostile witness/ignore/expiry and chooses HIDE while active operations retain MAINTAIN.

No new engagement contact is published. Group cover dispatch requires that exact original observer, with no substitute leader after observer loss. Existing cover/refuge/path/restoration/native task and ROE guards own every actual change. Native BLUE/GREEN and specialist/Zeus/mission priorities remain.

One-second failed probe and four-second accepted-cue cadence live only in current owner group state. No move/recovery clocks are renewed. Reuses existing CBE_AIPass_Danger_Enable; no settings/diagnostic Zeus module or extra movement owner.

DangerStep carries the original one-second geometry/identity cap into response, action and responsiveness publication. Delayed assessment cannot grant a fresh response window; other native cause durations are unchanged. Once accepted, actual movement still uses its original existing finite travel lease, not a renewed cue expiry.

Existing tick cadence, cover availability and native path planner may miss an urgent escape; no physical safety or interception guarantee.
